name: KIT proto-oncogene, receptor tyrosine kinase

function.text: KIT encodes the receptor for stem cell factor, a tyrosine kinase that regulates hematopoietic, melanocytic, germ-cell, and interstitial-cell lineages.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to gastrointestinal stromal tumor (autosomal dominant); piebaldism (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mucosal melanoma; Thymic carcinoma; Mast cell sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
